name: Maid-san de Asobou!
original_name: メイドさんであそぼう!
source:
Main character is the only son of a famous family. Parents send him to a private house in a village with  only one maid to learn country life. There is very little entertainment there. When maid finds a naughty book in the house, she finds a way to provide the necessary entertainment for her master.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是名门望族的独子。
父母把他送到乡下一栋私宅，让他体验乡村生活，屋里只有一名女仆。
那里几乎没什么娱乐可言。
女仆在屋内发现一本下流书籍后，想到了给主人提供必要娱乐的办法。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
